rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — C3 (Internal Consistency Check (Defined Terms)) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Perturbed MSA; the five inconsistencies are true of this fictional instance; recall of the real filing cannot collide with the gold.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Each finding quotes the exact problematic language (no paraphrase presented as quotation). TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing an inconsistency not in the excerpt; Presenting a paraphrase as a quotation. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Quoting the actual problematic language verbatim.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, C3.term.employees] §3.01(e) 'employees' where defined term is 'Service Provider Personnel' (narrows background checks) [highest priority]; [critical, C3.term.work_product] §8.01 'work product' where 'Deliverables' applies (assignment ambiguity) [highest priority]; [minor, C3.term.damages] §11.03 'damages' where 'Losses' applies (narrows Customer's indemnity obligation); [minor, C3.term.customer_image] §8.02 'Customer Image' undefined in Article I; [minor, C3.term.crossref] §3.01(i) provisions referenced by description with no section cross-reference.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] States the correct defined term AND why the substitution matters legally for each finding; [major] Does NOT flag §12.01 or §11.01 — both use terms correctly.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Organized by location; each finding: location + problem + correct usage + risk.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
